programs.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programs.desc: Follow Foodwise hosts Tianran and Hannah as they visit Xishuangbanna, the home of Pu’er tea. While there, they’ll explore night markets, taste the local Dai and Hani specialties, and celebrate the Dai New Year in style. From fishing, encountering elephants and hiking to ancient tea gardens, experience all that Xishuangbanna has to offer.

programs.title: The Pulse of Modernization
programs.desc: Following real people, this documentary showcases contemporary developments in China’s ongoing economic exploration. From low-altitude aircraft to smart farms, robots to open-source models, this documentary shows pioneers determined to embrace change and innovation in action. Where else could you find such a vivid picture of China-style modernization.
